commands.command: set -u; echo '=== SERIAL DEVICES ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.* /dev/tty.* 2>/dev/null || true; echo; echo '=== USB TREE (Espressif/serial relevant lines) ==='; system_profiler SPUSBDataType 2>/dev/null | grep -E -B3 -A12 'Espressif|JTAG|Serial|USB JTAG|CP210|CH34|CH910|FTDI' || true; echo; echo '=== ESPTOOL PROBE ==='; . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; found=0; for p in /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/cu.SLAB_USBtoUART* /dev/cu.wchusbserial* /dev/cu.usbserial*; do [ -e "$p" ] || continue; found=1; echo "--- $p ---"; python -m esptool --port "$p" --baud 115200 chip-id 2>&1 || true; done; [ "$found" -eq 1 ] || echo 'No candidate cu.* serial devices found'
